ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) ventral surface with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized at the distal tips and scattered across the mid-lobe regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black contiguous region across the central 90% of fluke area; high-contrast white geometric blobs mapped to the outer lateral tips; sparse, circular white mottling distributed non-uniformly across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch dividing the fluke lobes with clearly defined inner boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-to-moderate amplitude serrations along the trailing edge; distinct peaks and valleys most prominent on the outer thirds of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge displays a concave trajectory toward the median notch, with a convex sweep toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct circular high-contrast pixel clusters (white) concentrated on the distal lobe tips and scattered as individual rosettes across the ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions detected on the upper-mid section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy calcified barnacle clusters creating three-dimensional protrusions at the lateral-most points of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple deep indentations on the trailing edge of the right lobe proximal to the tip, breaking the otherwise continuous serration pattern.
